item.title: Conflict spreads across Middle East, oil prices jump, Iran names new supreme leader as war enters 2nd week
Video appears to contradict Trump claim that U.S. wasn't responsible for deadly Minab school blast
item.summary: New footage shows what an expert investigative group says is likely an American Tomahawk missile hitting a compound in southern Iran, metres from the school where a deadly unclaimed blast killed more than 165 people at the start of the war raging in the Middle East.

item.title: As oil prices spike, G7 opts not to dip into emergency reserves for now
item.summary: Oil prices spiked to near $120 US a barrel before falling back on Monday as the Iran war intensified, threatening production and shipping in the Middle East and pummelling financial markets.

item.title: Iran’s allies and foes, explained
item.summary: Countries across the Middle East are being pulled into the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran. How long will their opposition to Iran hold?

item.title: What we know about Iran's new supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei
item.summary: Iran on Monday named Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his father, Ali Khamenei, as supreme leader, signalling that hardliners remain firmly in charge in Tehran more than a week ‌into its conflict with the United States and Israel.

item.title: When you do the Iranian drone math, the U.S. has a big problem
item.summary: Iran is reported to have thousands of cheap attack drones, but shooting each one out of the sky costs the U.S. and its allies millions. For The National, CBC’s Eli Glasner breaks down the math and the problem it reveals about modern air defence strategies.

item.title: As war takes its toll in Iran, some still hope for regime change
item.summary: Iran's ambassador to the United Nations said 1,332 Iranian civilians have been killed in the conflict so far. With the war now in its second week, some opponents of Iran's governing regime are conflicted by the U.S.-Israeli attacks on their country.

item.title: At least 42 people killed in Kenya floods
item.summary: The death toll from heavy rains and flooding in Kenya's capital, Nairobi, and elsewhere has nearly doubled to 42, the government said ‌in a statement issued late on Sunday.

item.title: Live Nation, U.S. Department of Justice reach settlement in antitrust trial
item.summary: The trial in the case began last week after a judge in February rejected Live Nation's bid to dismiss ​the lawsuit.

item.title: Former rapper and Gen Z's candidate poised to win Nepali election by landslide
item.summary: In a resounding victory that is guaranteed to reshape Nepal's politics, rapper-turned-politician Balendra Shah appeared headed for a landslide win in the South Asian country's first polls since youth-led protests toppled the previous government last fall.
